description: This file defines a PHP client class for interacting with Amazon DocumentDB Elastic Clusters via AWS SDK. It specifies method signatures for various operations related to clusters and snapshots, and extends a general AWS client class.

classes.name: Aws\DocDBElastic\DocDBElasticClient
classes.description: A specialized AWS client for interacting with Amazon DocumentDB Elastic Clusters, providing methods for cluster and snapshot management.

methods.name: applyPendingMaintenanceAction
methods.description: Applies a pending maintenance action to a cluster.

methods.name: createCluster
methods.description: Creates a new DocumentDB Elastic Cluster.

methods.name: getCluster
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specified cluster.
